Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 — Zombies

BO7 Zombies

The complete guide — all six round-based maps, every main quest step-by-step, every Wonder Weapon build, every boss, perks, wall buys and toy quests, plus the shared systems underneath: augments, Pack-a-Punch, Cursed Mode, GobbleGums and the Super Easter Egg. Pick a map to open its full guide. Tap the circle beside any step to tick it off as you play — ticks live only for this visit.

Pick a Map

Play in release order for the story: the crew chases the Shadowsmiths across the Dark Aether, and beating Ashes first pays off later — Veytharion's Blessing carries into the Astra, Totenreich and Kowakujo boss fights. Every map also has 7–8 Survival variants with no quest; Survival rewards land at Rounds 10 / 25 / 50.

Before You Drop In

The stuff that works on every map — learn it once, use it six times. Plus the endgame that ties all six maps together.

New to BO7 Zombies? Start on Ashes of the Damned in Directed Mode — it guides the main quest with on-screen objectives and caps the round at 15 so the horde never out-scales you while you learn. Side quests are disabled in Directed, so graduate to Standard once the steps feel familiar. Cursed Mode is the hardcore ruleset (1911 start, no loadouts, no minimap) and only unlocks globally once the first team beats the Ashes main quest.

Systems
Shared Systems — Every Map

How BO7 Zombies Works

Everything on this page works identically on all six maps. If you know BO6, the headline changes are: a 13th perk (Wisp Tea, plus Mule Kick's return), Cursed Mode with a fourth Pack-a-Punch tier, Overheal, T.E.D.D. Tasks, and a tighter economy — suppressors give less Salvage and the first rarity upgrade costs more than it did in BO6.

Essence, Salvage & The Upgrade Chain

  • Essence is your points — kills, hits and round bonuses. It buys doors, perks, Pack-a-Punch and armor.
  • Salvage drops from zombies and is spent at the Arsenal (weapon rarity + ammo mods) and the Crafting Table (equipment and support). BO7 tightened the economy: suppressors give less Salvage than in BO6.
  • Pack-a-Punch: Tier I 5,000 / Tier II 15,000 / Tier III 30,000 Essence. In Cursed Mode: 10,000 / 25,000 / 50,000, plus Cursed-only Tier IV for 100,000.
  • Weapon rarity at the Arsenal: Common → Uncommon 750 → Rare 2,000 → Epic 4,500 → Legendary 9,500 Salvage (16,750 cumulative). Ultra rarity is Cursed-only. Ammo Mods cost 500 Salvage each. Aether Tools raise rarity one tier.
  • Build Codes let you share weapon builds — new in BO7.
  • Overheal / Health Overcharge: temporary +100 max HP — new in BO7 and a real boss-fight buffer.
Spending order that wins runs: doors to Pack-a-Punch → Jugger-Nog → Tier I Pack → armor → Speed Cola / Quick Revive → rarity at the Arsenal → Tier II/III Pack → the rest of your perks. Ray Gun and Ray Gun Mark II are in the Mystery Box on Ashes, Astra, Paradox Junction and Totenreich if you need a shortcut.

All 13 Perk-a-Colas

First perk costs 2,500 Essence, and each perk you buy adds +500 to the next (3,000 / 3,500 / 4,000…). Free perks don't raise the price. You lose one perk when downed — unless you've made it Permanent by getting the same perk twice in a match. Der Wunderfizz arrives after a number of perks bought (it scales with player count) or at Round 25, and sells the perks a map doesn't place.

Augments — 192 at launch

Every enhancement (perk, ammo mod, field upgrade) has 8 augments: 4 Major + 4 Minor — 24 enhancements × 8 = 192. You equip 1 Major + 1 Minor per enhancement; unlocking all 8 in a track unlocks its “Extra Slot” Minor, letting you run 2 Minors. Research unlocks at Level 11, and BO6 augment research carries over — if you ground BO6, you start BO7 ahead.

GobbleGums — 47 at launch

41 return from BO6 plus 6 new: Aftertaste, Requipment, Power Vacuum, Round Off, Armor Gettin', Gift Card. Rarities: 10 Rare, 11 Epic, 12 Legendary, 7 Ultra, 7 Whimsical. You can hold max 3 in a match, bought from Mr. Peeks GobbleGum Machines on-map. BO6 GobbleGum inventory carries over. New in BO7: GobbleGum recycling — crush a gum for Essence. Whimsical Gums only come from successful Exfil.

  • Ultra — Perkaholic (every perk, instantly — keep one in reserve for boss fights), Wonderbar! (next Box spin is a Wonder Weapon), Hidden Power (held weapon straight to Legendary).
  • Legendary — Exit Strategy (triggers Exfil immediately — the toy-banking shortcut), Crate Power, Wall Power.
  • Pack-building advice: one survival gum (Perkaholic / Phoenix-style save), one economy gum, one boss gum (Idle Eyes / Free Fire class). Never walk into a point-of-no-return step without a full pack.

New Mechanics, Enemies, Exfil & T.E.D.D. Tasks

  • T.E.D.D. Tasks: timed objectives that appear every ~4–6 rounds and pay out reward chests. Worth doing early; skip them mid-quest-step.
  • Fog zones (Ashes): infinite zombies, no points. Cross them in Ol' Tessie, don't farm them.
  • Exfil: first chance Round 11, then every 5 rounds (16, 21, 26…). The nearest phone booth is marked. Kill the HVT (e.g. an enhanced Zursa) inside a 2-minute window, then interact again to leave. Exit Strategy gum triggers Exfil immediately. Exfil is the only way to earn Whimsical GobbleGums — and the only way to bank Super Easter Egg toys.

Ashes of the Damned
Launch Map · Nov 14, 2025 · Quest “Dust to Dust”

Ashes of the Damned

The biggest Zombies map in years: six POIs — Janus Towers Plaza (spawn), Vandorn Farm, Blackwater Lake, Ashwood, Exit 115, Zarya Cosmodrome — joined by roads drowned in fog. Ol' Tessie, your drivable pickup, is transport, mobile Pack-a-Punch base and, by the end, a boss-killing weapons platform. This is the longest quest in BO7: 30 steps. Do it in Directed first. Rewards: “Oorah!” Dempsey operator skin, 10,000 XP, Standard Quest Complete calling card — and Veytharion's Blessing, which helps in three later boss fights.

Main Quest (30)GauntletBossPerks & Wall BuysToy Quest

Main Quest — “Dust to Dust”

Tap the circle beside a step to tick it off. Golden rule: never use a jump pad while carrying the Aether Barrel — it drops. Drive. And keep Tessie repaired: the last two steps are vehicle fights.

Part 1 — Tessie, power & Pack-a-Punch (Steps 1–5)

  1. Install T.E.D.D.'s Head in Ol' Tessie. Janus Towers Plaza, Server Room (1,250 Essence door). Melee the floor vent/crate, take T.E.D.D.'s Head, fit it to the truck.
  2. Power: Blackwater Lake. Clear the orange blobs on the Infested Power Pump within 30 seconds (retry next round if you miss it; Semtex helps), pull the switch on the Cabin's 2nd floor. Pick up the Jar of Spores from the cans by the kitchen sink.
  3. Power: Ashwood. Same 30-second pump clear on the bridge pump, pull the switch. Open the Sheriff's Office while you're here.
  4. Pack-a-Punch on Ol' Tessie. Drive Tessie into the Ashwood Garage and use the workbench inside to install PaP on the truck.
  5. Power: Vandorn Farm. Same pump clear; switch on the Barn's 2nd level. Place the Jar of Spores on the dead horse on the road between the farm entrances — you'll come back for it in Step 10.

Part 2 — Tessie upgrades & serum ingredients (Steps 6–13)

  1. Abomination Carcass upgrade. Exit 115, Reba's Diner: kill the Cook zombie inside (it only spawns inside) for the Freezer Key, open the freezer (upper-right corner), take the Abomination Carcass. Install it at Ashwood Garage — Tessie gains a beam attack.
  2. Hoard Husk Chunks. In the fog/roads between POIs, find a glowing purple Overgrown Hoard Husk / Aether Flora plant. Destroy it with Tessie's Abomination beam and grab the chunks fast — fog zombies swarm; a Decoy helps.
  3. Human Bones. Vandorn Farm Barn: throw a Combat Axe at the foot of the hanging corpse nearest the hay stack. The foot drops; burn it with a Molotov (a free one sits by the Ashwood garage entrance) → Human Bones.
  4. Ravager Eyes. During a Ravager round (usually Round 5–6), trigger a Saw Trap (2,000 Essence; Exit 115 or Vandorn Farm, lasts a round) so the trap kills a Ravager. Pick up the eyes.
  5. Widow's Lantern. Wait 3 rounds after placing the spores on the horse (Step 5), return to the dead horse and collect it.
  6. Defeat Uber Klaus. Janus Towers Plaza, from Round 8, near the semi-trailer / western shipping container left of the Exfil Machine. Two phases: destroy the two shoulder discs, then aim for the head. Drops the Stabilizer Chip.
  7. Rescue Klaus. Ashwood Sheriff's Office: install the chip on the cell panel (“UPDATE REQUIRES RESTART”), then throw 2 Stun Grenades back-to-back into the cell so both hit him. Klaus follows you — his HP decays over time and he teleports to you if you get far away.
  8. Aether Barrel. Take Klaus to Zarya Cosmodrome, Support Systems (underground). Ping the panel by the barrel (“Go” ping) so Klaus opens the scanner. Stand in the red scanner circle until it fills. Unconfirmed Duration: Game8 says 1 minute, another guide says 30 seconds. Collect the Aether Barrel — it must travel in Tessie; if lost, it returns to Zarya.

Part 3 — Charge the barrel, win the Gauntlet (Steps 14–16)

  1. Charge the barrel at 3 pumps. Insert it at Ashwood, Blackwater Lake, then Vandorn Farm (Game8 recommends Blackwater → Ashwood → Vandorn; the farm cellar is the final destination). Hold off the horde at each; you have 1.5 minutes between charges. Drive — jump pads drop the barrel.
  2. Box puzzle. Deliver the charged barrel to the cube in the Vandorn Farm cellar. Take the jump pad from Janus Towers Plaza toward the farm; mid-air, note the 3 red symbols on the barn roof. Enter them on the cube's three sides (any order) and interact with the eye.
  3. Get the Necrofluid Gauntlet. Locked-in green-orb trial: shoot each green orb, then reload to pull it in. Clear all 6 to keep the weapon.

Part 4 — The Serum (Steps 17–20)

  1. Powder of the Forgotten. You need Wisp Tea (machine NW Zarya Cosmodrome; or a free one via the static TV on Vandorn Farmhouse 2nd floor — follow the ghost girls). In the Ashwood Tailor Shop (across from Double Tap), kill zombies until a Wisp spawns and lead it into the mirror. The mirror shows a cube — shoot it with the Gauntlet → Powder.
  2. Mysterious Limb. Kill a Zursa with Tessie's beam — the final hit must be the beam. Guaranteed spawn Round 16; or spawn one early by shooting 3 skulls in Zarya with the Gauntlet until their eyes glow green (Support Systems behind the yellow railings near the DS20 Mirage wall buy; Flame Trench beams by PhD Flopper; rusted opening at the rocket base).
  3. Syringe. Zarya Cosmodrome, small building north near the Wisp Tea machine: on a shelf next to binders in the Control Room.
  4. Serum in Yuri's Lab (building with the big red star, SW of the Cosmodrome). Six ingredients go on the bench: Widow's Lantern, Hoard Husk Chunks, Ravager Eyes, Human Bones, Powder of the Forgotten, Mysterious Limb. Interact with the powder to reveal 3 Pigpen-cipher lines on the chalkboard (random order each run; Powder is always required, plus 3 of the other 5). Interact with the 3 matching objects in order — vial turns red = correct, black = wrong (retry next round). Offer blood at the vial — the donor's health drops to a fraction, so the Gauntlet holder should do it (Gauntlet kills restore health) — then survive the room lockdown/soulbox until purple smoke fills the room.

Part 5 — Fog keys, DG-2 & frozen lightning (Steps 21–24)

  1. 3 Keys in the fog. Shoot each glint with the Gauntlet and reload to pull the key in. Each key has 3 random spawn points and a debuff — drive Tessie to bypass the debuffs: Bruin (yellow, no health regen), Nightbird (red, melee only), Terrapin (green, slowed). Roads reported: Crashed Rocket road (Ashwood→Zarya), Orda Graveyard (Ashwood→Exit 115), Grounded Ship (Ashwood→Vandorn). Unconfirmed Sources swap which key goes with which road — the debuff-to-key mapping above is consistent, the road mapping needs an in-game check.
  2. Seal of Sorrow / Rabbit Alley. Ashwood, behind the PaP building near Jugger-Nog: insert the 3 keys into the prism/artefact; each removes a chain. A cutscene plays; the DG-2 Turret Barrel appears.
  3. Install the DG-2 Wunderwaffe on Tessie at the Ashwood Garage workbench.
  4. Freeze the lightning — Exit 115. Make a temporal Gauntlet: shoot the floating Clock Tower above Ashwood Garage with the DG-2, then shoot a clock face with the Gauntlet (absorbs purple energy; one face per round). Shoot the Service Station rooftop clock at Exit 115 to freeze time ~1 minute. Lightning strikes every 2 rounds (Gas Station red, Service Station yellow, Reba's Diner blue). Wake and lead 3 coloured zombies to their matching streaks within 1 minute: the Waitress (Melee Macchiato — melee the cash register in Reba's Diner → blue/rooftop), the Engineer (via the Klaus radio/call device, stomping by the Service Station car → yellow), the Trucker (ram the red truck at the back with Tessie → red/Gas Station). Miss = wait 2 rounds; killed zombies respawn next round.

Part 6 — Rocket, artefacts, film & the point of no return (Steps 25–30)

  1. Slow the Zarya arrays + launch the rocket. Temporal Gauntlet again: shoot both spinning radar dishes at Zarya to slow them (one face-charge per tower, a different clock face each time). In the Control Room (behind Wisp Tea), read the Pigpen words on the right monitors and shoot the red button on 6 monitors when the correct number flashes. Codes verified in two sources: ROCKET 17-14-02-10-04-19 · ENGINE 04-13-06-08-13-04 · LAUNCH 11-00-20-13-02-07 · WEAPON 22-04-00-15-14-13. A wrong entry restarts the whole step next round.
  2. 4 artefacts — Vandorn Farm. Temporal Gauntlet again: shoot the floating clock, check the farmhouse wall clock (3, 9 or 12), stand on the matching Roman numeral on the floor (XII head of table, III right, IX left), look at Pa at the head of the table until his eyes turn red, shoot him with the Gauntlet. Collect: Tasty-Face (upstairs cabinet right of Stamin-Up), Ma's Chalice (cellar bathtub), Junior's Fun-Face (barn mask below the window near Death Perception), Pa's Pigsticker (garage table by the armour wall buy). Place all 4 on the red circles outside and defend 2 minutes (soulbox; Decoys / Cymbal Monkeys recommended).
  3. Film reels — Blackwater Lake. Interact with the blue light behind the house (near the Mystery Box) to turn on the projector. Temporal Gauntlet again — shoot the projector with it: it shows 4 images in random order. Shoot the 4 film reels in that order (fixed spots: shack with the Armour wall buy; above Melee Macchiato; under the steps beside the Ammo Cache; shack with the Crafting Table, shelf in the other room). Wrong order = restart next round.
  4. Hellion Horn. Blackwater Lake, Speed Cola bedroom upstairs: interact with the blue energy on the box near the bed and pay 2,000 Essence to call Klaus by radio. Direct him to the box — he pulls out the Hellion Horn, then heads to the lake and triggers a vote.
  5. 12 souls in the fog — POINT OF NO RETURN. Vote with Klaus at the lake. Drive Tessie over 3 souls on each of 4 routes (12 total): Monolith Forest (Blackwater→Janus), Collapsed Tower (Janus→Vandorn), Grounded Ship (Vandorn→Ashwood), Lost Cabins (Ashwood→Blackwater). Wait ~20 seconds for souls to spawn (audio cue from T.E.D.D.); be fast and avoid wrecking Tessie — teammates should shoot the explosive plants ahead of you.
  6. Defeat Veytharion — collecting all 12 souls teleports you to the boss arena at Blackwater Lake. Fight guide below.

Wonder Weapon — Necrofluid Gauntlet

  • Earned at Step 16 — not a Box pull. Shoot = spike/bolt; reload = recall / pull-in, which is how you grab orbs, keys and crystals from distance.
  • Quest-critical: Serum, fog keys, film reels and the toy quest all require it. It also heals you for damage dealt — that's why the Gauntlet holder donates blood in Step 20.
  • Ray Gun and Ray Gun Mark II are also available on this map from the Mystery Box.

Boss Fight — Veytharion

  • A giant flesh mass / sphere of heads — and a vehicle fight. Ram Tessie into it to reveal weak spots. The DG-2 turret (auto-fires solo, manned in co-op) aims at open mouths, exposed wounds and the underneath carriage.
  • When it goes immune, shoot the DG-2 so the shot deflects to the ground and makes a power/light beam — drive through the beam, then ram again.
  • Avoid the red skulls (red circles — they explode on impact) and the electric beam (hide behind pillars). It spins (“Beyblade mode”), fires lasers and missiles, and spits zombies.
  • Unconfirmed Single-source: the fight grants 2× Max Ammo and 2× Max Armor at the start, respawning after each damage phase.
  • After the win: click Continue, not Exit. Interact with the artefact / Mysterious Object above the frozen lake at Blackwater Lake to unlock Relic collection in Cursed Mode. Veytharion's Blessing then helps in the Caltheris, Dravakar and Nyxara fights.

Toy Quest — Ol' Tessie Toy

Prerequisite: all six main quests complete. Run it in Standard (or Cursed). You need the Necrofluid Gauntlet, the Dark Flare field upgrade, and a Fumigator (or Plant Spray). Full Super Easter Egg rules are in the Super section.

  1. Find the ghostly Twins in the fog/Ashwood (Lost Cabins, Grounded Ship, near the boat, behind the cabins between Blackwater and Ashwood, by the Ashwood zipline). Approach them; they relocate to the barn at Vandorn Farm.
  2. At Vandorn Farm, shoot the smoking Toy Box on the little windmill with the Gauntlet; reload to pull it down.
  3. Hit the fallen box directly with Dark Flare to open it.
  4. Monolith Forest (between Janus Plaza and Blackwater): find 3 purple crystals on large rocks. Shoot each with the Gauntlet, reload to pull it down, then spray it with the Fumigator to summon a meteor.
  5. Go to Blackwater Lake and fumigate the meteor; advance a round if it doesn't open. Take the blue crystal / Element 115 shard it leaves.
  6. Return the shard to the Toy Box at Vandorn Farm → Ol' Tessie Toy.
  7. Exfil with the toy (it must be seen entering the portal). It banks on the shelf in Her House on Rex Infernus.
Astra Malorum
Season 1 · Dec 4, 2025 · Saturn's Rings

Astra Malorum

Thurston Observatory fused onto a giant skull-shaped asteroid in orbit of Saturn. You spawn at the Crash Site — Ol' Tessie's wreck is right there — and the whole map orbits one problem: O.S.C.A.R., a roaming guardian automaton you cannot kill with guns. You trap him three times to earn the Wonder Weapon, then ride his own portal to Mars to face Caltheris, a Shadowsmith. Note No verified quest name exists for this map in sources — this guide doesn't invent one.

Power & PaPLGM-1 & O.S.C.A.R.Main QuestBossPerks & Wall BuysToy Quest

Power & Pack-a-Punch

  1. Go to the Observatory Dome and find the Harmonic Oculus (the piano/organ).
  2. Collect the Harmonic Components beside dead zombies — two is majority-verified (Game8, GamesRadar, GameRant, Niche Gamer, SkyCoach): one in the Luminarium, one in Machina Astralis. Unconfirmed Two outlets claim a third, “near the Observatory Dome entrance.”
  3. Install them in the Oculus, activate power, and defend the lockdown (~45–60 seconds) while Pack-a-Punch descends. PaP is in the Observatory Dome.

Wonder Weapon — LGM-1 & The Three O.S.C.A.R. Traps

LGM-1 (Little Green Menace-1) isn't built on a bench — O.S.C.A.R. drops it on his third trap death. Gather the parts in any order after power/PaP:

  • Damaged Drone — alert O.S.C.A.R. so he raises his Drone Shield; shoot down one of his hovering drones/UFO projectiles (some sources say a PaP'd weapon is required).
  • Aberrant Wiring — shoot the one flickering/blinking lamppost (random location each match).
  • Car Battery — with a PaP'd weapon, shoot Ol' Tessie at the Crash Site until the hood/bonnet pops open; take the battery. Unconfirmed Sources split between “shoot the hood” and “shoot the gearshift.”
  • 3× Absolute Zero Fragments — buy the Cryo Freeze ammo mod at the Arsenal and shoot 3 glowing purple Aetherium/Dark Aether Crystals around the map (e.g. Stargazer's Courtyard); each drops one fragment.

Kill O.S.C.A.R. 3 times — one trap per round, any order. The 3rd kill drops the LGM-1:

  1. Luminarium — Electro-Volt Projector / Stellar Dissector: install Damaged Drone + Aberrant Wiring + Car Battery into the trap (interact with the switch while holding all three). Lure O.S.C.A.R. inside and activate to overcharge his battery until he dies. Unconfirmed GameRant says destroy his drones to overcharge; CoDZombiesGuides says just keep him in the room, no shooting needed. First kill also drops the Shiny Trinket (feeds a Ravager ally 3× across rounds/areas — side quest, not main-quest required).
  2. Museum Infinitum — Rocket Ignition: place the 3 Absolute Zero Fragments in the rocket relic's exhaust via its side panel. 5-second countdown — lure O.S.C.A.R. to stand behind the thruster so the blast kills him.
  3. Observatory Dome — Telescope / Sun Laser: shoot 5 hissing/leaking gas valves around the Dome in quick succession (random spots: portal room, under/around PaP, catwalk above PaP; only one fumes at a time; they reset if you're too slow — Unconfirmed some sources say 6 valves, majority says 5). Interact with the left side of the Harmonic Oculus and aim the star-chart crosshair at the Sun; a giant laser fires onto the PaP platform — lure O.S.C.A.R. into the beam until he dies. Zombies do not attack while you're in the star chart.
O.S.C.A.R. rules: effectively unkillable except in traps; he respawns after each trap kill; and he appears during later steps — do not kill him off-script where the quest needs him alive (next step needs him talking).

Main Quest — After The LGM-1

  1. Rock Saw. Museum Infinitum, in the corner/display cabinet by the doorway to the Crash Site (shoot the glass). Pick it up.
  2. Eavesdrop on O.S.C.A.R. From Round 10, follow him from behind at ~15–30 m without being detected (turn subtitles on; ping him to judge distance) until he plays a Thurston report naming 3 planets in quick succession. Convert to numbers by distance from the Sun: Mercury 1, Venus 2, Earth 3, Mars 4, Jupiter 5, Saturn 6, Uranus 7, Neptune 8. Example: Earth-Mercury-Mars = 314. Unconfirmed TheGamer also lists Pluto as 9 — whether Pluto can appear is unconfirmed.
  3. Cryo Chamber Key. Enter the 3-digit code into the terminal on the NW pillar in the Observatory Dome (by PaP). A lift lowers left of PaP; jump on and interact with the corpse → Cryo Chamber Key.
  4. Thurston's Brain. Machina Astralis, bar through the south doorway: use the key on the Cryopod. It opens on Silas Thurston's corpse; O.S.C.A.R. and purple-eyed zombies spawn — quickly saw/interact to extract the brain. Note Sources differ on “saw the head off” vs “hold interact” — follow the on-screen prompt.
  5. Perfusion Machine. Luminarium: swap Thurston's brain for the monkey brain in the container/Perfusion Machine on the table. Interact again → 60-second lockdown; defend it. Pick the machine up (you move at walking speed) and carry it to Machina Astralis; place it in the machine beside the teleporter pad and interact again to connect.
  6. Mars coordinates. Observatory Dome telescope (re-align via the valves if needed): centre the crosshair on Mars and note the 4-digit coordinates bottom-left by the DEC label. If only 3 digits show, add a 0 before the final digit (e.g. 42,5 → 4205). Enter them in the terminal on the 2nd floor of Machina Astralis (above the Armour wall buy).
  7. Reading List & busts — Archive of Orbis. Interact with the brain/machine in Machina Astralis to display Thurston's Reading List (3–6 random book titles). In the Archive there are 3 statue busts, each with bookshelves beside it (3 books per shelf). For each bust, count how many of its shelf books are on the Reading List and interact with that bust that many times. Unconfirmed Timing: Fandom says after the first bust you have 15 seconds for the other two or you wait a round; TheGamer says only at the start of a round. If correct, a ceiling tile above the ladder slides open — climb up, take the model Neptune, and place it in the planetarium (the pole missing a planet, top floor of Machina Astralis).
  8. Planet alignment. Find 3 notes (planet + cardinal direction, e.g. Saturn SE): desk in Machina Astralis, table in Archive of Orbis, small table at the back of the Luminarium lecture hall. In the Machina Astralis planetarium, shoot planets until each sits at its noted direction (compass around the Sun model; closest position counts).
  9. Open the portal — go to Mars. Interact with the brain to reboot the portal: a 2-minute defence lockdown. O.S.C.A.R. fires UFOs/drones at the teleporter — destroy the beeping drones heading for the portal (not his Drone Shield drones) until the bar fills. You're sucked through to Mars.
  10. Mars — Ascendant Eye. Pick up the brain jar from the centre platform, place it in the Aegis Terminal at the top of the stairs, and interact to rebuild the portal (loud noise; a scarab spawns out of bounds). Look through the windows at the back: shoot 4 outer pylons in order — Back Right, Back Left, Front Right, Front Left — then the pylon above the portal entrance. The Ascendant Eye flies into the arena; use the periodic low-gravity to jump up and grab it. Place it in the strange golden device in the south-east / far-right corner. (If the Eye leaves, re-shoot the final pylon / re-interact with the terminal and repeat.)
  11. Harmonize the pillars. Shoot the antennas atop 5 pillars in the Martian temple with the LGM-1; each plays a note and shows a symbol. Return to the Observatory Dome piano/Harmonic Oculus: a small screen shows symbols in sequence. Unconfirmed Count: TheGamer says 4 symbols flash; Fandom + CoDZombiesGuides say 5, one being a “static noise” symbol for the pillar NOT in the code. Return to Mars and interact with the pillars in the shown order, then the remaining pillar. Correct = blue/bright flash + a Thurston quote; wrong = red, wait a round.
  12. Boss. Interact with the brain/Aegis Terminal one last time to summon Caltheris. POINT OF NO RETURN — fight guide below.

Boss Fight — Caltheris (4 Phases, Mars Temple)

  • Phase 1 — Caltheris (Skull): giant floating rock skull, immune to normal weapons. Kill zombies near the two Defence Towers; souls fill a tower; when full, hold interact on the machine at the top of the stairs to fire a laser at her. Repeat 3×. Attacks escalate per laser: tracking lasers, then meteors (ground indicators; they leave lava pits), then Toxic Zombies + toxic air (take refuge at the top of the stairs). A meteor shower runs between Phases 1–2.
  • Phase 2 — Caltheris (Golem): rock golem, damageable with normal weapons. Use the LGM-1 to break her armour, revealing glowing blue crit spots (chest/shoulder) — focus those with your primary. Attacks: rock throws, ground slam in melee range.
  • Phase 3 — Caltheris Ascendant: bigger, stronger, more aggressive; opens with an immune phase swarmed by Armoured Zombies (restock armour). The ground slam must be jumped. Break armour → crit spots again.
  • Phase 4 — Caltheris the Needle: fastest and most aggressive; ground slam much stronger; thrown rocks leave lingering electric pools that shred armour/health — avoid them (PhD Flopper's Environmentalist minor augment lets you slide through them). Veytharion's Blessing spawns at the top of the stairs at the start of this phase if you previously completed Ashes of the Damned — infinite ammo + lethals for its duration.
  • General: the LGM-1 (especially upgraded) is top boss DPS. Shock Mimics spawn throughout all phases, plus Toxic Zombies. Armour wall buy + Ammo Cache are on Mars (armour near the entrance/top of stairs — 10,000 Essence per Game8's boss guide; ammo cache left side against a pillar). Recommended: Frenzied Guard, Stim Shots, LT53 Kazimirs / Decoys / Cymbal Monkeys, self-revive.
  • Ending: killing her starts the final cutscene immediately; you're teleported back to Thurston Observatory with perks, bonus points, power-ups, Aether Tools, Aetherium Crystals, Legendary weapons, Salvage and a random Wonder Weapon spawned around you. Rewards: “Bottled Up” Nikolai operator skin, Astra Malorum calling card, 10,000 XP (Standard; the Early Completion card was only before Directed Mode, Jan 8, 2026).

Toy Quest — Caltheris Toy (The Longest Toy Quest)

Prerequisite: all six main quests complete. Bring patience — this one chains four other side Easter Eggs.

  1. Activate PaP + power the telescope. Complete the DG-2 turret side Easter Egg and install the turret on Ol' Tessie at the Crash Site. Unconfirmed Exact DG-2 step: Dexerto says Semtex a rock near the Twins' spawn so it floats into place, then parkour off it into the atmosphere to grab the turret barrel; AllThings.How describes it only as “complete the DG-2 turret side Easter Egg.”
  2. Find the floating wooden Toy Box outside the Luminarium; push it toward the Crash Site with explosives (Semtex/Impact Grenade — a zombie + web blocks one push; clear them and continue). Throw an LT53 Kazimir beneath it to pull it to ground (inside the electric field).
  3. Lure O.S.C.A.R. to the box and destroy him with the DG-2 turret — that removes the electricity and opens the box.
  4. Complete the grandfather-clock side Easter Egg (melee every clock to slow time); during the effect, look through the telescope near the piano in the Observatory Dome to catch/reveal a UFO.
  5. Progress the main quest until Mars is accessible (power the Resonance Pillars with the LGM-1) — but do not trigger the boss fight.
  6. On Mars, throw two Shock Charges onto the rod between the two coils/glowing plates near the Ascendant Eye area — a correct hit summons the UFO overhead.
  7. Complete the Lamp Wisp side Easter Egg to collect upgraded (golden) wisps. The UFO flashes a sequence matching suspended Mars objects (flamingo, lava lamp, space suit, toilet — order changes each game). Use wisps on the objects in the shown order (or hit all of them). The final object leaves a small alien.
  8. Take the alien back to the Crash Site Toy Box and swap it in → Caltheris Toy. Exfil to bank it on the Rex Infernus shelf.
Paradox Junction
Season 2 Reloaded · Mar 11, 2026 · Nuketown, Two Timelines

Paradox Junction

Nuketown twice: the Destroyed / Future (post-nuke) you spawn in, and the Past / Clean (1950s) behind the Temporal Conduit (1,500 Essence, manual — and dog rounds auto-teleport you). Pack-a-Punch sits on Trinity Ave in both timelines once unlocked. Two perks are quest-required: Wisp Tea (Goggles) and Death Perception (Headset). This map has the most source disagreements in BO7 — every one is flagged where it happens.

Main QuestBlundergat → SundergatBossPerks & Wall BuysToy Quest

Main Quest

  1. Unlock Pack-a-Punch. Grab the Truck Keys from the corpse in Yellow House Backyard (east side). Play to the Round 6–7 dog round — you're auto-teleported to the Past. Use the keys to move the oil truck blocking the way. In the Past (southern area), destroy the Temporal Storm / four Space-Time Knots: shoot all four storm points; purple-eyed zombies tethered to each knot spawn — kill them to damage the knot. Repeat for all four. PaP appears on Trinity Ave.
  2. Build the Blundergat (4 parts — full build in the next section), then upgrade it to the Sundergat (also next section). The Sundergat is required for the Music Box and Cymbals escort steps. PaP names: Blundergat → The Sweeper; Sundergat → Holistic Dichotomizer.
  3. Goggles + Headset → Toy Box (order flexible vs the RC-XD step). Goggles: Future — shoot the speaker pole / loudspeaker left of PaP (Trinity Ave, facing south); the Goggles drop outside the fence. You need Wisp Tea: summon a Wisp (shoot a zombie) and it carries the Goggles inside for pickup. Headset: requires Death Perception to see it. One of 3 spawns in Destroyed Nuketown: Yellow House backyard (mannequin's hand near the perk machine); Green House upstairs (rack/shelf); bins/trash cans by the fence in the Cul-de-Sac / in front of Green House. Place both in the blue Toy Box in the Past, Trinity Ave (near the exfil point).
  4. Cymbals (third Toy Box item). Future — find the red ball (3 spots: on ammo crates SW of Trinity Ave; Yellow House roof east of Trinity Ave; pillar on the Yellow House backyard balcony). Shoot it down, then shoot it to roll it onto the white X in Green House Backyard. Return to the Past — the Twins draw a four-square outline. Pass the Ball minigame: melee the ball after each bounce, keep it inside the white lines, one bounce per hit; don't leave the lines. Completing it spawns the cymbals. Shoot the cymbals with the Sundergat to activate them, then kill zombies with the Sundergat nearby so they absorb souls and move to the Toy Box. The screen flashes white when done.
  5. RC-XD → garage → Chalk. Find the RC-XD controller — one of 3 spawns: Yellow House garage shelves; crate near PaP; behind Green House / against the white fence in Green House backyard. Drive the RC-XD up the ramp(s), boost-jump over crates/debris into the garage (battery timer on screen; retry by re-finding the controller if it runs out). Detonate at the red gas tank / large garage door to open the garage (right of PaP). Inside, pick up the head on the crate (left) — shortly after, Chalk spawns on the ground; pick it up.
  6. Swing set / The Twins. Past: Yellow House Backyard swing set — shoot the wooden seat off and pick up the Swing Seat. Future: same swing set — attach the Swing Seat, then place the Chalk. A Twins cutscene plays. The red tool box in the nearby Yellow House garage is now interactable.
  7. Fireplace — seeds → tree → firewood. Future, Yellow House garage: open the red tool box on the shelf, take the Irradiated Seeds / Plant Seeds. Past: plant them in the dug hole / mound of dirt near PaP (south, by the hedge). A small tree grows — soul box: kill zombies with the Blundergat nearby to charge it; the screen flashes white when full. Future: the tree is now full-sized. Throw Tomahawks / Combat Axes at it — 3 hits = 3× Strange Firewood; collect them. Past: put the firewood in the fireplace inside Yellow House and light it with a Molotov.
  8. Hopscotch → Music Box escort. Future, Trinity Ave, right of Der Wunderfizz: stand on the big blue X until it glows blue. (Game8: another player activates the Temporal Conduit to return to the Past; solo, use the conduit yourself.) Past, same spot: a hopscotch grid appears. Interact with the glowing orb over No. 1 (camera goes third-person). Jump 1 → 10/12 and back down in order, avoiding the black smoke/spot. Unconfirmed Dexerto says 1→10 and back; Game8 says 1→12 and back. Fail = ~30-second wait before retry. A glowing Music Box appears. Shoot it with the Sundergat to activate it, then kill zombies with the Sundergat while standing close so it absorbs souls and moves. Escort it to the top of the Yellow House fireplace. A Max Ammo confirms completion.
  9. Piano Teacher → Piano. Future, Green House backyard: find the special zombie The Piano Teacher (distinct look, less aggressive, sometimes standing/moving away from the horde; climbs through the fence). Throw a Psych Grenade at her (Dexerto) — she runs to the piano inside the house. Quickly return to the Past; she interacts with the piano and explodes. If you don't return in time she dies — retry next round. Unconfirmed Game8 says shoot her with a gun carrying the Brain Rot ammo mod instead of a Psych Grenade. Future: find 8 glowing blue notes around Destroyed Nuketown (bus in the middle; fence behind the yellow building; garage door; wall opposite the M8A1 wall buy; bunker behind the greenhouse; rock near PaP; wooden panel near the phone box; fence left of the cul-de-sac). Each blinks 1–8 times = its order. Interact in ascending order. Past: go to the piano in Yellow House (Dexerto) / Green House (Game8 — Unconfirmed which). Play the notes written on the wall when the piano glows yellow. Solution reported as A–F–G–E–F–E–C–E (Game8) / 8–6–7–5–6–5–3–5 (SkyCoach, same key mapping). Dexerto says the note order “varies in-game” while Game8 says the piano solution is the same every time — Unconfirmed, unresolved. If you run out of time you're removed from the piano and retry after a moment.
  10. Bouncing Ball → Golden Note escort. Future: shoot 3 floating zombies out of bounds outside the fences (check the backyards). Their blue souls lead to a blue X on Trinity Ave (near the southern truck). Past, same spot: a large circle appears. Interact with the floating ball to start the minigame. The ball bounces and launches zombies into the air — shoot all 3 in the air before they hit the ground, 4 times in total. Fail if a zombie touches the ground, you shoot too early, or you leave the circle; restart after ~2 minutes. A Sundergat charged shot (ricochet) is highly effective. The Golden Note spawns in the circle. Kill zombies near it with the Sundergat to charge it; escort it to the piano in Green House. The piano glows gold when it arrives.
  11. Doomsday Clock → boss trigger. Future: stand on the bus near the Blundergat bench and shoot the clock hands on top of Green House until both are at 0. Game8 method: the white hand moves while adjusting the red — bring red to 2 first, then white to 1, then both to 0. Unconfirmed SkyCoach says set both hands to 12 o'clock; the majority says 0. Activate the teleporter, then shoot the red hand once more just before the teleport animation ends (co-op: one player teleports while another shoots). Past: unique music plays; the Twins appear at the piano, then move to the Toy Box → fireplace → swing set, where a gold orb appears. POINT OF NO RETURN — prep (PaP, perks, ammo/armour, GobbleGums) first. Interact with the orb (co-op: vote) to start the boss.

Wonder Weapon — Blundergat → Sundergat

A triple-barrelled shotgun, built from 4 parts in any order, assembled at the workbench inside the truck in the Cul-de-Sac (Future) — melee the bench first to open the flap, then interact to build.

  • Sealant: Past, Yellow House upstairs, bookshelf (bottom-left / bottom shelf).
  • Barrel: Future only. Kill ~10 zombies near the yellow Cysts on walls so souls feed the cyst; it pops and drops loot. The Barrel is a random drop — repeat with other cysts (including two in the southern area) until it drops.
  • Hammer: Future — pick up the SO3 vial from the desk upstairs in Yellow House; fill it at the Green House sink → H2SO4 (acid). Return to the Past and use it on 12 mannequins with heads (smoke appears over the correct head). Only 2–3 mannequins per vial — refill in the Future as needed; vial use is not shared in co-op. Then check the mannequin spots in the Future — one holds the Hammer.
  • Stock: Future — find black goo/corruption on walls (3 spots: Yellow House garage north wall; Green House upstairs north wall; Trinity Ave corridor / Der Wunderfizz area). One makes a distinct sound/chime when you're close. In the Past, throw a Semtex/explosive at that wall to blow a hole; return to the Future and collect the Stock from the hole.
  • Upgrade → Sundergat: in Destroyed Nuketown, one fire tornado spawns per round (backyards or Trinity Ave / southern alley). Walk near it to release a Tortured Zombie (blue aura). Lead it to the red truck / workbench in the Cul-de-Sac and kill it with the Blundergat only, right in front of the bench — its soul is absorbed. Keep other zombies away: if it tethers to/absorbs nearby zombies it can die prematurely. Repeat for a second Tortured Zombie next round, then a third: a Mimic — same lure-and-kill-with-Blundergat rule. Travel to the Past, melee the bench open, place the Blundergat inside. Return to the Future, melee the bench open, collect the Sundergat (adds a charge function for more damage).

Boss Fight — The Dark Heart (3 Phases)

  • The boss is immune except in damage windows. Each phase runs the same loop: (a) free three relics (Toy Box, fireplace, piano) trapped in black goo, (b) defend them one at a time while the Twins charge them inside a barrier, (c) damage phase — shoot the glowing orange/red cracks / weak spots on the Dark Heart.
  • Phase 1: fill Cysts/black blobs with souls by killing zombies near them to reveal the relics; defend all three; then damage. Max Ammo + Max Armor drop after the damage phase.
  • Phase 2: same structure, but relics are revealed via yellow floating orbs / Space-Time-Knot-style orbs (shoot the orb, kill the tethered purple-eyed zombies that spawn). More zombies; the Dark Heart moves faster and fires slow explosives; Rad-Hounds spawn — kill them first.
  • Phase 3: fire tornadoes spawn; lead Tortured Zombies to the relic spots and kill them there to reveal the relics; defend again; final damage phase until its health is depleted. Shock Mimics and Rad-Hounds spawn in this phase; the Dark Heart fires explosives and fire tornadoes even while immune.
  • Ending/reward: an animated calling card is reported (SkyCoach). Unconfirmed Exact cutscene contents are not described in text guides.

Perks & Wall Buys

Perk locations are randomised on this map. The Call of Duty Wiki states perk machines “can spawn in any of the possible Perk Machine locations around the map” — if a perk doesn't spawn where you expect, buy it from Der Wunderfizz (Future Nuketown). Treat any fixed perk map for Paradox Junction as unverified. Perks in play: Jugger-Nog, Stamin-Up, Speed Cola, Double Tap, PhD Flopper, Vulture Aid, Wisp Tea, Death Perception, Melee Macchiato, Elemental Pop, Quick Revive.

Wall buys — Future (Destroyed): Velox 5.7 (pistol), Razor 9mm (SMG), M10 Breacher (shotgun), M8A1 (marksman, Trinity Ave east), MXR-17 (AR, on the truck south Trinity Ave, right of PaP), VS Recon (sniper). Past (Clean): CODA 9, Echo 12, Dravec 45, XR-3, MK.78, Carbon 57. Level II & III Armour Vests are wall buys in the same spots in both timelines. Unconfirmed Wall-buy prices are not comprehensively confirmed.

Sources: Game8 — Paradox Easter Egg · Dexerto — Paradox Junction walkthrough

Toy Quest — Twins Dolls

Prerequisite: all six main quests. Standard mode recommended. Bring a Psyche Grenade (tactical) and Aether Shroud.

  1. After the Round 7 dog-round teleport to the Past, interact with the chalk toy chest drawn on the garage door between the two houses near spawn.
  2. Upstairs in Yellow House, throw a Psych Grenade at the chalk question mark by the bookshelf to reveal a key; interact with the chalk chest again to pull it out as a real chest.
  3. In Destroyed Nuketown, collect Mrs. Peeks (pink plush) parts — spots include Trinity Ave rooftop, a stack of boxes on a roof, the truck bed near PaP, inside the RC-XD garage, the top-right corner of Yellow House, on top of the bunker behind Green House. Unconfirmed Part count: Dexerto says collect all six parts; AllThingsHow/BoostingFactory say three parts drawn from six possible spawns.
  4. Take the parts to the bus in the Cul-de-Sac — a timed chase starts: a purple Mrs. Peeks projection appears around Nuketown; grab/collect her before the timer ends (solo is very tight; Stamin-Up / PhD Slider help).
  5. Pick up the finished Mrs. Peeks doll from the bus roof (go prone if the prompt won't appear standing).
  6. Return to the Past and place her in the toy chest — it pays out loot (including a Ray Gun and Legendary Aether Tool, per AllThingsHow) and gives you the Twins Dolls.
  7. Exfil (normal exfil round or Exit Strategy GobbleGum; kill the exfil HVT) — the toy only banks on a successful exfil, confirmed by it appearing on the shelf in Her House on Rex Infernus.
Totenreich
Season 3 Reloaded · Apr 30, 2026 · Norway, Frozen In Time

Totenreich

A Norse fishing village pulled into the Dark Aether over a Group 935 site, frozen in time. Areas: Eidskallen Landing (spawn), Eidskallen Square, Fishery Island (central, PaP), Tyr's Head/Foot, Dry Docks, Skallen Market, Burial Grounds, Lighthouse / Beacon Island, Blodheim Hall, Stave Church, Core Foundry, War Factory, Storm Bridge. The collapsed giant robot Tyr is both a quest location and, in the finale, your tag-team partner against Dravakar.

Cold MechanicMain QuestJotunn StarBossPerks & Wall BuysToy Quest

The Cold — Read This First

  • Cold Snap (Frost) special rounds hit roughly every 5 rounds (Unconfirmed frequency — secondary guides only): temperature drops, vision obscures, movement slows, and Frost Zombies emerge from the fog.
  • Counters: go indoors (you warm naturally); hold a charged Jotunn Star (its stored flame keeps you and your team warm); the Wildfire field upgrade; or stand in a Flammenfalle three-headed flamethrower trap's heat zone (which also passively charges the Jotunn Star).
  • In the boss fight, blizzards shut down left/right/middle arena sections (red radius on the minimap) — avoid them, or have a teammate hold out the Jotunn Star.

Main Quest

Guides group this chain differently (Game8 lists 14 steps, ZombiesCodex 11 — same chain). This guide uses the 11-step grouping. Tap to tick.

  1. Activate PaP (Glocke Drop). From Eidskallen Landing, head north to Eidskallen Square and unlock the zipline to Fishery Island. Repair two broken power lines: one in Skallen Market (east side), one in Core Foundry (west side). Go to Tyr's Foot (north) and enter Tyr's Head through the slightly open, yellow-lit hatch / suction circle. Inside, interact with the terminal reading “Modus Offline” to activate Tyr. You're ejected via tube — 1 minute; landing location is random each match. A zombie is ejected with you and splats, dropping an Admin Keycard — pick it up. Take it to the War Factory admin door (west side); open with the panel on the right (zombies aggro when it opens). Inside, take the Glocke Drop Controller from the top of the terminal. Go to the centre of Fishery Island (pulsing purple area) and initiate Tyr Sync — survive 1 minute inside the area while zombies spawn. The Glocke Drop lands and PaP spawns on Fishery Island. Keep the free Glocke Drop controller — you need it again at Step 7; a replacement costs 2,000 Salvage at a crafting table.
  2. Build the Jotunn Star — full build in the next section (Chain Link → Chili Chunks → Lantern → Burial Grounds → constellation puzzle → Astrid → Lighthouse parkour). It drives most later steps.
  3. Crowbar → Flak Gun Round → Transmitter. Crowbar: after the Jotunn Star, on Lighthouse 2nd floor, turn around — metal shelves next to the window; pick it up. Cargo Manifest: War Factory Admin Room; read the note/manifest on the shelf next to the large console. It lists the IDs of 4 Cargo Boxes around the map — note the ID for the box containing PZGR .39 (e.g. V-7; the ID is randomised every run). Find the cargo box with the matching red ID code on its side and open it with the Crowbar — it drops the Flak Gun Round. Wrong boxes inflict temporary negative effects (EMP / cough-gas) that wear off. Fire the flak gun: take the round to the flak cannon on the southwest side of the Lighthouse; load it, then hit the back of the flak gun with the Jotunn Star to fire it at the robot head at Eidskallen Landing (spawn). Transmitter: zipline to Eidskallen Landing; interact with the broken machinery at the base of the damaged robot head to dig through the wreckage — the Transmitter drops; pick it up.
  4. Wunderbarrage Controller (Tyr's Head light puzzle). Put the Transmitter in Tyr's Head. Lights below blink a specific number of times — count them: two sets of numbers, the second a few seconds after the first. Record them (they blink fast; you only have ~1 minute inside Tyr's Head). Left/right light = left/right dial. Thaw the ice on the tower rope in Core Foundry (bottom of the tower) with a Molotov or a Napalm Burst weapon. Climb the tower via the rope and input the first set of numbers on the machine (oscilloscope / frequency dials), watch the missiles fire, then interact again and input the second set. Grab the Wunderbarrage Controller in the room southeast of the tower (still Core Foundry). Save it — it bombards the 02 Building near Melee Macchiato at Step 8. If lost/used, craft another at a workbench for 1,750 Salvage.
  5. Uranium #1 — Fishing Rod → Irradiated Ravager. Get the fishing rod on Fishery Island, outside near PaP. Find a Radioactive Fish (bright glowing green, jumping in the water) at one of the fishing spots (all have a red rod holder). Interact with the rod holder to fish; the rod glows blue after a few seconds — interact again to catch it. Miss the timing and you lose the rod. The fish flies off and spawns a horde of Ravagers elsewhere. Find the horde and kill the elite Irradiated Ravager in the middle (identifiable by its cloud of dark green gas). It drops Uranium #1. If no horde spawns, advance a round.
  6. Uranium #2 — ARC-XD → Genetic Lab. Get a free ARC-XD at Eidskallen Square (on a box near the flame trap) or craft one at a crafting table (Stave Church, Dry Dock, or Lighthouse). Core Foundry: find the wall vent on the left side of the zipline area; attack the vent cover to open it. Drive the ARC-XD through the vent and down the staircase; use the speed boost to launch over the ramp onto the boat, through the opening into the Genetic Lab; detonate the ARC-XD near the red drums blocking the doors. Enter the breached Group 935 Genetic Lab on Fishery Island (near PaP). In the green-lit hallway (past two holding cells) are doors 1–5; two doors have a nuke symbol beneath their number — note them. Jar code: 1=A, 2=B, 3=C, 4=D, 5=E. The two nuke-marked numbers give two letters (e.g. 3+4 = C and D). Find the 2 red jars marked with those letters in the lab and place them on the machine next to the holding cell holding the 2nd Uranium (a voiceline confirms). Interact with the big Claw on the lab table — it dissolves, leaving the Necrospike. Take it to the holding cell and lockpick the cell with it; grab Uranium #2.
  7. Uranium #3 — Glocke Drop (floating zombies). Craft a Glocke Drop Controller for 2,000 Salvage at any crafting table (Stave Church, Dry Dock, Lighthouse) — or use the free one saved from Step 1. Use it in an open area with a big horde. It periodically emits a pulse that lifts zombies into the air — kill the floating zombies mid-air within the short window. Unconfirmed ZombiesCodex: kill only the floating orange zombies; Game8: kill every zombie mid-air. The Glocke Drop then drops rewards including Uranium #3. If it doesn't drop, craft another controller and repeat.
  8. Atomkraft Core — Claw Machine + charge + delivery. Use the Wunderbarrage Controller to open the 02 Building near Melee Macchiato (aim outside, close to the building, to open all entrances). Inside, play the Claw Machine: connect all cells except two to put the arrow onto the green bar (Game8 links a dedicated solution image; the exact pattern isn't transcribed in text guides). Fail = electrocuted, wait until next round. Success yields the Atomkraft Core (built from the 3 Uranium). Charge it: carry the Core to Eidskallen Landing; place it on the pallet near the Quick Revive perk machine. Go inside Lief's Boat Repair and hit the power switch — a 2-minute charging process; defend the area. Deliver it: pick up the charged Core and carry it to Storm Bridge (north). Ice Spikes randomly rise from the ground and knock you back on contact. Place the Core on the drum in the middle of Storm Bridge (Game8: black barrel with a yellow stripe). Tyr aligns with the drum — a live Tyr vs. Dravakar monster-vs-robot event triggers.
  9. Dravakar Shard → Sunstone (Blodheim Hall lockdown). After the Tyr/Dravakar event, pick up the Dravakar Shard at Tyr's Foot (western end of Storm Bridge). Take it to Blodheim Hall (Eidskallen Square) and place it on the unlit fire pit / roasting spit. Get a Disciple Injection: a free one lies on the ground inside Eidskallen Stave Church (next to Skallen Market); if already used, craft one at a crafting table for 2,500 Salvage (closest table inside the Church). Light the fire pit with the Jotunn Star (ranged attack) — it glows with purple fire. With zombies nearby, use the Disciple Injection to transform into a Disciple. Use the Disciple's Scream on the Shard until it starts spinning slowly, then use the Disciple's Grab Zombie attack to throw zombies onto the spinning shard. Once enough are thrown, you're locked inside Blodheim Hall (teammates outside are force-teleported in) for a mini-boss fight. Defeat the named Necropincer (a named variant of the large pincer/claw elite; they also spawn elsewhere, e.g. from Mr. Peeks eggs) plus the horde. Defeating it frees the Sunstone from the Shard; pick it up from the ground in front of the fire pit.
  10. Rune Dial puzzle — light three bonfires. Go inside the Stave Church and place the Sunstone on the pedestal in the middle. Hit it with the Jotunn Star to activate — a beam shows symbols above the church. Look above the church: symbols with three arrows pointing at some of them. Light the bonfires in the order indicated by the horizontal lines on each arrow: 1 line = 1st, 2 lines = 2nd, 3 lines = 3rd. Symbols are randomised every run. Roam the map for floating piles of wood with the correct symbols above them. Light each with the Jotunn Star's charged Flame Strike (charge it first by killing zombies — leave plenty of zombies in the round to charge it).
  11. Boss: Dravakar. Return to Tyr's Head and interact with the console/machine to initiate travel to the Shadowsmith's Lair and start the final boss fight. Prep first — fight guide below.

Wonder Weapon — Jotunn Star (Build)

The Jotunn Star replaces your melee weapon (dedicated melee slot). Double-swing melee; killing zombies charges it (3–5 kills ≈ a charge, up to 2 charges held) — a charged shot is a ranged fireball / Flame Strike (alt-fire). Holding it out while charged keeps you and nearby teammates warm against the freeze. It drives most later steps — refill before each alt-fire step, and don't enter the boss dry.

  1. Chain Link: Dry Docks (southwest island) — press the Crane Button in the Titan crane room to temporarily lower the crane-held metal wall/plate. Wall-jump off the middle of the wall and press interact mid-air at the tip of the ship/boat to grab the Chain Link (you can't land on the ship; press the button again if you miss).
  2. Chili Chunks: Storm Bridge (north, near Deadshot Daiquiri) — take the tin from the crate behind the truck. Place it on the table with the other Chili Chunks in Skallen Market (by the tree near the Mule Kick perk machine). Timing: place it before Round 10 and the Round-10 special round is the trigger; place it later and the next round becomes the special round.
  3. Lantern: on that special round, a Zursa Bear HVT spawns (named Vornaketh, a white Zursa, per one guide — Unconfirmed). Kill it to drop the Lantern. Note: a Zursa hit can pull you into a forest realm — survive/beat it there to return.
  4. Burial Grounds door: from Skallen Market, head NE, right of the church; install the chains on the left side of the sealed Burial Grounds door and hold interact to repair/open it, accessing the underground room.
  5. Constellation puzzle: place the Lantern on the altar in the underground room — constellations light up. Facing the torches (east side), interact with the moving wall constellations in the order shown on the altar: Left → Right → Back → Front (back = torch side, front = stairs side). Wrong pick: the wall symbols vanish — interact with the tabletop symbol to restart.
  6. Astrid (ghost): a blue ghost, Astrid, appears above the altar and flies toward the Lighthouse. Follow her; at each stop, kill purple-eyed zombies near her to fill the meter and make her move again (stops around the Burial Grounds edge → Skallen Market → near the zipline toward the Lighthouse; keep one zombie alive to carry the fill across a round boundary).
  7. Lighthouse parkour: when the meter fills, floating ice platforms spawn. Start the jumping puzzle on the non-lighthouse side, climbing rocks (do NOT zipline); Astrid spawns at checkpoints creating more platforms. Falling respawns you on a platform; only one player needs to complete it in co-op. At the Lighthouse, watch the ice giant rise from the ocean, run onto the platform, drop down and wall-bounce across to the top. Climb the stairs/ladder into the lamp room and take the Jotunn Star off the table. You're teleported back down (to Lighthouse 2nd floor, per Game8). Tip: in the lamp room, take Tyr's Bell off the table BEFORE the Jotunn Star — the room seals once you hold the Star.

Boss Fight — Dravakar

  • Prep: Triple PaP, full armour (ZombiesCodex: no Max Armour drops in the boss fight), all perks, and a hitscan AR for boss damage (ZombiesCodex advises avoiding the Ray Gun — projectile travel makes you miss; Ray Gun Mark II or MXR-17 are the recommended boss weapons).
  • Phase 1 — Red weak spots: Dravakar brawls with Tyr and is initially immune; stay mobile, clear smaller enemies, and shoot the glowing red weak spots whenever they appear. Avoid the wide AoE ice field (pulsing red circle on the ground — move out of it).
  • Phase 2 — Gjallarfrost: after ~¼ health, Dravakar goes immune and summons Gjallarfrost — floating ice Viking heads, immune while rotating. When one stops and its eyes glow red, it conjures ice spikes at you. Throw a charged Jotunn Star Flame Strike (or a grenade) into its open mouth to knock it down; then focus fire while it's vulnerable on the ground. Destroyed heads can drop ammo and armour. Repeat — later rounds summon 2, then 3 heads. Between head phases Dravakar returns: shoot the red weak spots, avoid frozen zones and rock/meteor barrages (hide behind stone pillars/boulders; the boss-arena heat traps in the middle/left/right also negate freezing and let you fire Jotunn Star ranged attacks freely, per SkyCoach).
  • Final phase — eyes + meteor barrage: the arena closes in on the sides, trapping you in the middle. Dravakar's weak spots shift to his face / glowing red eyes. Constant meteor barrage — dodge left-to-right and go prone to avoid meteors while shooting his face.
  • Ending: once his health is depleted, Tyr returns and finishes Dravakar off, triggering the cutscene and completing the Easter Egg — freeing the Shadowsmith (per ZombiesCodex's framing). Unconfirmed Exact cutscene dialogue/details are not transcribed in text guides.

Toy Quest — Guardian Toy

Prerequisite: all six main quests. Standard mode recommended. Exfil with the toy to bank it. Bring the Wildfire field upgrade and a fishing rod (from Olaf's Cod Cranker barrel).

  1. Behind Ms. Loven's Antique Shop near the dock at Eidskallen Square, look into the water for a small floating iceberg holding the Toy Box.
  2. Place the fishing rod on the red handle on the railing at the nearest fishing spot and activate Wildfire so the rod catches fire; after a few seconds reel it in — the iceberg is pulled ashore. (Do not interact with the rod prematurely — guides warn it can disrupt the sequence.) Melt the remaining ice with fire (e.g. a Molotov) to reveal the Toy Box.
  3. Complete the Jotunn Star build, then go outside the Lighthouse onto the broken ledge and prone toward the edge to pick up the hidden crossbow The Silent Heir.
  4. Go to the Burial Grounds to spawn King Draugvald the Undying (elite king zombie) and kill him with the Silent Heir — the final blow must come from the crossbow; he drops a crown. Unconfirmed Sportskeeda says PaP the crossbow twice before fighting Draugvald; other toy guides don't mention this.
  5. Place the crown in the Toy Box to receive the Guardian Toy.
  6. Exfil via the phone booth on an exfil round (kill the exfil HVT) to bank it.
Kowakujo
Season 4 Reloaded · Jun 25, 2026 · Feudal Japan, Dark Aether

Kowakujo

A distorted version of Takeo Masaki's family castle, surrounded by active volcanoes and lava. The crew must free the final Shadowsmith and recover the World Seed — and the quest is a murder mystery: who killed Takeo's father, the Shogun? Enemies: Oni, Hellhounds, Scorched Zombies, armoured zombies. Directed Mode arrived Season 5 (July 23, 2026), round cap 15. Required perks: PhD Flopper (cage step) and Death Perception (cat-capture step). The Ninja Kite glider (500 Essence, from the rooftop fish-kite pole near the Shogun's Sanctum) is your fast travel.

Main QuestNekomancerBoss NyxaraPerks & Wall BuysToy Quest

Main Quest — The Murder Mystery

Structure: unlock PaP → get the Nekomancer → light 11 lanterns → fill five Evidence Boxes (Suspect, Accomplice, Poison, Location, Motive) → solve the mystery in the Meditation Room → Onryo → Nyxara.

  1. Unlock PaP / acquire the World Seed. Recapture the Kitchens Ward (stand by the banner, NE) and the Training Area Ward (west). Remove the two Gate Glyphs on the double doors in the Central Courtyard. Fight through armoured zombies at Tenshu Entrance to the War Room. Defeat the Oni there; loot the Shogun's Hanko it drops. Interact with the gold dragon crest in the War Room to open the Shogun's Sanctum. Inside, lure zombies near the World Seed until they glow purple, then kill them to charge it — PaP spawns.
  2. Get the Nekomancer Wonder Weapon (full build in the next section).
  3. Light 11 Lanterns with the Nekomancer, in rapid succession (start at Training Area for the long-range shot). Missing a shot or taking too long resets the puzzle; retry next round. When all 11 stay lit, a blue ghost spawns in the War Room.
  4. Evidence Box 1 — Suspect Evidence. Interact with the ghost in the War Room (cutscene). Use the Ninja Kite (500 Essence, glide right / W+D) from the Sanctum roof to grab the Fox Mask from the castle roof edge. Take it to the Storage Rooms: mask memory minigame — masks glow blue in sequence, then zombies wearing masks spawn; shoot them in the same order, 3 rounds. Wrong order = fail until next round; don't leave the room or use Aether Shroud. Then follow the flying Fox Mask to 3 rooms and shoot it to collect evidence: Takeo's Case (Collapsed Study), Takeshi's Pipe (Workshop), Mitsuhime's Comb (Omen's/Onsen Baths). Submit all 3 in the Meditation Room evidence shelf (portrait 1 appears).
  5. Evidence Box 2 — Accomplice Evidence (3 items). Gardening Shears: get a bucket (Tea Garden tatami room / Onsen Baths 2nd floor by the slippers / Stables between MPC-25 and Death Perception), fill it with water. Carry it to the Flower Garden — no sprint/jump/getting hit (the bucket has 3 water charges; losing one means refilling). Water 3 green shrubs (broken bridge; south path by the orange wildflowers near Wisp Tea; west side near the Armor wall buy, reached via a small gap in the north wall). A Gardener elite spawns, immune until you shoot the golden glowing flowers; kill him, take the Shears + Gardener's Notes. Mercantile Abacus: in the Kitchens, melee the basket of red fruit (shelf by the Arsenal) to drop one. Leave, advance a round; mid-round return — a zombie is crouching eating the fruit. Lead it to the Staging Area hut (SW of Kitchens, by the lantern), kill it in front of the barrier to spawn a Merchant elite (tanky, regens by eating fruit; use the Nekomancer). Kill him, take the Abacus + Sales Note. Noble's Hat: craft 3 Decoy Grenades (1,500 Salvage, Crafting Table — Training Area). Throw one at each of 3 closed wood windows overlooking lava in Training Area simultaneously; the Noble appears and throws grenades — throw them back into the windows to damage/kill him. Take the Hat + Diary page. Submit all 3 in the Meditation Room.
  6. Evidence Box 3 — Poison Evidence (3 items). Monkshood Flower: knock the Empty Pouch down from the beam above the Training Area Ammo Cache (Nekomancer alt-fire or a grenade). Pick the Monkshood Bud (small dark-purple flower, Flower Garden by the broken bridge end). Plant the bud in the empty flower pot at Tenshu Entrance (left on entry). Stand in a Fissure event ~30 sec–1 min to get Volcanic Ash. Melee the pink Cherry Blossom tree repeatedly until it has a gold aura, then run circles around the tree for the blossom buff. Return to the pot, run circles in front of it until it glows pink; collect the Monkshood Flower. Plum Pit: in the Kitchens, melee the basket of green fruit to drop one, then jump/stomp on it until squashed; pick up the Plum Pit. Pufferfish: Storage Rooms scroll rack — hit the scrolls so all end up inside their slots (adjacent scrolls move opposite). Take the Pestle (+ Death Records note) from the centre slot. Take it to the Mortar (black-rimmed bowl, large stone stove in Kitchens near the Mystery Box); it glows green. Kill zombies near it (soul-box style; the Nekomancer hairball helps) until a white flash, watch the cutscene, then take the Pufferfish from the shelf in the tatami-mat area. Submit all 3 in the Meditation Room.
  7. Evidence Box 4 — Location Evidence (3 items, all via the Sake Cup). Collect 2 Ceramic Shards (War Room floor by the bloodstain/body; Meditation Room 3rd panel after submitting the Poison evidence — both auto-go to the Tea Garden workstation). Repair the Sake Cup at the Tea Garden, advance a round, interact with it for a memory cutscene. Then place the Sake Cup on the floor tray and defend it from zombies in turn at: War Room (left corner) → Horse Statuette; Collapsed Study (left of Wunderfizz) → Calligraphy Brush; Tea Garden (room by the Mystery Box) → after the wave, a high-HP Hellhound carrying the Tea Whisk spawns somewhere random — follow its growl/bark and kill it. Submit all 3 in the Meditation Room.
  8. Evidence Box 5 — Motive Evidence (2 items). Netsuke of Brothers: in the Stables, once the lava has cooled, find the small brothers statue in the centre of the cooled lava; throw a Molotov at it (craftable if needed), then pick it up after burning. Crest Medallion: interact with the clock in the Storage Rooms (rubble pile) — note the 4 random numbers it points to, in order. Find the blue-glowing number symbols (1–4) in Outer Ward, Stables, Flower Garden, Central Courtyard, noting which location is 1st/2nd/3rd/4th. During the next Assault Wave, kill the red-glowing flag-bearing zombies; their red orbs fly to the Staging Area. There, 5 flags are marked 1–5; carry flags and place them at the 4 locations so each location's flags sum to the corresponding clock digit (e.g. code 9,3,2,2). Return to the clock — the numbers glow blue if correct — interact to get the Crest Medallion.
  9. Solve the mystery (Meditation Room, 5 portraits + Zodiac Clock). Suspect (Portrait 1): Mitsuhime — place Mitsuhime's Comb. Accomplice (Portrait 2): activate Ghostly Riflemen Traps until a blue ghost rifleman appears and names Gardener / Merchant / Courtier (= Noble); place the matching item (Gardening Shears / Mercantile Abacus / Noble's Hat). Poison (Portrait 3): re-read the Death Records — the cause-of-death wording decides it: “contaminated or noxious food… emesis” = Pufferfish; “contaminated or noxious plant” = Plum Pit; “evidence of paralysis” = Monkshood Flower. Time of poisoning: the Known Toxins note — Pufferfish 3 hrs, Plum Pit 4 hrs, Monkshood 2 hrs; the Death Records gives the time of death as a zodiac animal (e.g. Hour of the Boar). Set the Zodiac Clock beside Portrait 1 to the time of death, then move it counter-clockwise 2/3/4 places per the poison. Location (Portrait 4): the painting decides it — Koi/Fish painting = Tea Whisk; Mountain painting = Horse Statuette; Bird painting = Calligraphy Brush. Motive (Portrait 5): Crest Medallion (always). Interact with the Incense Burners either side of the altar; if correct, an orange orb spawns — follow it to the World Seed. (Wrong solution spawns an elite; retry next round. Unconfirmed Single-source: the left incense burner reportedly pauses zombie attacks for 60 sec if you don't shoot.)
  10. Defeat the Onryo. Interact with / Purify the World Seed; you're teleported to the Central Courtyard to fight the Onryo, a souped-up Oni (periodically immune, throws masks; Game8: shoot the red floating masks to bring him back if he disappears). Defeat him.
  11. Defeat Nyxara (final boss). Returned to the World Seed; cutscene — Nyxara the dragon snatches the World Seed. Fast-travel via the fish kites near PaP to Nyxara's Run. Fight guide below.

Wonder Weapon — Nekomancer (Build)

Collect 3 parts, then craft the Maneki-Neko (tactical equipment — do not throw it away) at the work table left of the Vulture Aid machine: Furin (bell) — Staging Area, Stables, or Training Area; listen for ringing, check structures. Maneki-Neko (cat statue) — Kitchens, white and easy to spot. Karakuri (doll) — Castle: Workshop or Storage Rooms.

  1. Buy PhD Flopper (Storage Rooms). At Tenshu Entrance near the Cherry Blossom Tree, dolphin-dive under the hanging cage so the PhD explosion drops it; pick up the cage and throw it into any lava pool to free the cat.
  2. A Volcanic Fissure consumes one of four areas; kill a zombie at that area's entranceway to reveal orange paw prints (possible spots: Stables before Staging Area, Flower Garden before the building, Kitchens before Central Courtyard, Training Area before Stables). Kill another zombie ~7 m from the prints, in the direction they face, to reveal the next set; repeat until three groups form a circle.
  3. Throw the Maneki-Neko at the circle — a cat appears and is eaten by a spawning Abomination; kill it (shoot the open mouths for crits) to free the cat.
  4. Next round, with Death Perception, find the sleeping Nekomata (Kitchens ×2 spots or Training Area ×1) — orange-highlighted creaky floorboards must be avoided; crouch, sneak around them, interact to pick up the cat.
  5. Carry it to the World Seed (Shogun's Sanctum); it jumps on top, glows red and emits damaging shockwaves — melee the Seed between pulses until the cat drops. Unconfirmed Exact count varies by source (3 hits / “after every 5 red pulses”). Pick it up: Nekomancer.

PaP name: Tsunderera-Hime. Fire: single-shot Spirit Bolt; a charged shot fires a lingering damaging pool/hairball. Unconfirmed One source lists it as also obtainable from the Mystery Box; others describe only the build.

Boss Fight — Nyxara (Dragon, 3 Phases)

  • Core loop: kill flag-carrying Oni, carry their flag to a capture circle, stand in it until captured — a shield bubble forms that blocks Nyxara's attacks and zombies, giving you a safe DPS window. Shoot the glowing yellow/orange weak spots (eyes in Phase 1; more spots across body/wings/neck later; wings in Phase 3).
  • Phase 1: 1 flag/zone. Phase 2: 2 zones, electrified tornadoes, lava blasts, fire breath locking off arena sections. Phase 3: 3 zones, plus a fireball attack that can down you instantly.
  • Max ammo/armor spawn mid-arena between phases. Recommended gun: M34 Novaline (long-range, weak-point damage). The Nekomancer is recommended for the boss.
  • Ending: defeating Nyxara completes the quest and plays the final cutscene (Takeo's father's murder solved; World Seed recovered — Unconfirmed exact cutscene beats are not transcribed in text guides). Rewards: “Purified” Takeo Operator Skin, Calling Card, 10,000 XP; a unique Calling Card variant if completed before Directed Mode arrived.
