Toy Quest — Z-Rex Toy

  1. Unlock PaP (opens roof access). You need Tenshu Entrance, Kitchens, Staging Area, Training Area, Central Courtyard.
  2. Melee the cherry blossom (sakura) tree near Tenshu Entrance / the Mule Kick area repeatedly until it activates and grants a glowing overcharge effect (screen edges glow, petals). While active, go under the floating toy box above the castle rooftops and run in a tight circle — a pink blossom whirlwind pulls the toy box down; it opens and releases a bird. (First-tree location differs slightly by source — “near Tenshu Entrance and Mule Kick” vs “Sakura tree at the castle” — same area; exact tree Unconfirmed.)
  3. Guide the bird by meleeing cherry blossom trees in order — Kitchens (near Double Tap) → Staging Area → Training Area (near lava) — waiting for the bird to relocate after each. Don't skip or activate early; if the bird gets stuck circling, re-activate the Tenshu Entrance tree. Avoid advancing rounds mid-sequence if possible (reported to disrupt it).
  4. Regain the overcharge effect, go to the large sakura tree in the Central Courtyard, and run circles on/around the stump near the Mystery Box and Onryo rock — the whirlwind draws the bird in; a glowing origami swan/bird drops.
  5. Pick up the origami, return it to the toy box at Tenshu Entrance, collect the Z-Rex Toy, then successfully Exfil.
Rex Infernus
Season 5 Reloaded · Aug 20, 2026 · The Final Map

Rex Infernus

A shattered recreation of Dr. Monty's estate — Her House — in the Dark Aether: a circular design around the central Nexus Forge / PaP, with four Shadowsmith temples (Dravakar, Nyxara, Caltheris, Veytharion) as spokes, plus floating islands (Aranea, Spira, Ruinas Insula). The Warden (Jack McGregor) is the final antagonist of the BO7 Zombies storyline. Directed Mode arrived Season 6 (Sept 17, 2026), round cap 15; Directed rewards are the “Netherclaw” Warden's Blight skin, Calling Card, 5,000 XP. Traversal is by Void Claw grapple pedestals (green). Round gates: quest starts Round 3 (phone in Her House); Warden's Blight forest from Round 8; Exfil Round 11, then every 5 rounds. Recommended field upgrade: Aether Shroud.

Main QuestWarden's BlightBossPerks & Wall Buys

Main Quest

  1. Unlock PaP + Void Claw. Survive in Her House until Round 3; answer the ringing phone downstairs. The front door opens; exit through the portal to the Nexus Forge. Place the World Seed on the central pedestal — two Dread Skulls spawn. Shoot and follow the first Dread Skull into its temple, kill it, collect the Usurped Flame; return it to one of two braziers at the Forge. Repeat with the second skull/brazier. Then interact with the Crank Wheels to lower the Forge and activate PaP. Collect the Void Claw (grapple) from the pedestal beneath the Forge.
  2. Build the Warden's Blight Wonder Weapon (next section). PaP it immediately — its charged shot is required for later steps.
  3. Get the Eye of the Forge / upgrade the Void Claw. Stand at the Nexus Forge, look toward Her House with a scoped weapon; shoot the basketball in the collapsed roof — a symbol appears on the house. Each following round one more symbol appears (4 total); record the exact order (randomised per match). On the next Exfil round, shoot the 4 symbols in the same order (correct = they flash/pulse; wrong = they vanish — wait 4 more rounds + another Exfil). Start Exfil at the booth and kill the HVT — instead of leaving, you're teleported inside Her House. Go upstairs, face south, fire a charged PaP Warden's Blight shot into the bathroom/toilet — the Eye of the Forge is released. Collect it, survive the Ravagers + Doppelghasts that spawn in the house, answer the phone to return to the Forge. Place the Eye into a Void Pedestal to permanently upgrade that pedestal's Void Claw (the upgrade is tied to that one pedestal only — choose wisely). Note: this same sequence is also the first half of the Super Easter Egg Warden Toy quest.
  4. Repair the Nexus Forge. With the upgraded Void Claw, destroy 3 marked squares on the pillars around PaP, 6 squares on the west wall under PaP, and 6 on the east wall. Blow apart the webs behind the east/west walls (explosives or Warden's Blight). Turn the Crank Wheels to Surge Nexus; pull the lever under PaP to lock it. Use the 3 new Forge controls to aim the blue beam into the face of whichever Shadowsmith temple you want to cleanse.
  5. Solve the Veytharion stone-block puzzle (do this before cleansing; it unlocks the rain portal — rain is required to finish every temple cleanse). With Death Perception equipped (to see the hidden blocks), find 4 blocks in the Veytharion Sanctuary and drag them to the NW puzzle wall. KeenGamer's sequence: stack the left column bottom→top Fire → Air/Hand → Earth/Leaf → Water/Waves; transfer Fire+Air right via the centre dial; keep Fire right, return Air left, transfer Water+Air right; stack right Fire→Air→Water, move Fire+Air back left; transfer Earth+Air right, place Earth above Water; send Air back left, add Fire, transfer Fire+Air right; finish the right column bottom→top Water → Earth → Air → Fire. The wall opens, revealing the rain portal (blue well) — interact to complete. Unconfirmed This exact block-shuffle is from a single source (KeenGamer); other guides confirm only the outcome — treat the shuffle as single-source.
  6. Cleanse all four Shadowsmith temples — same loop per temple, specifics differ; order is your choice:
    • (a) Aim the Nexus Forge beam into that Shadowsmith's face/mouth.
    • (b) Obtain the offering: Dravakar — Blacksmith's Hammer (equip Shatter Blast, grapple into Dravakar Inner Sanctum, break the corner shields with Shatter Blast kills); Nyxara — Ancient Scroll (equip Shadow Rift, rack up Shadow Rift kills — the hidden forest is fastest); Caltheris — Shimmering Thread (pull purple orbs down from the sky with the Void Claw and interact until it drops); Veytharion — Woven Sash (only spawns while raining — trigger rain at the blue well — at one of 3 spots: behind the Mystery Box ledge at Ruinas Insula, the left rock outside the map at Spira Insula, or Aranea Insula looking down from NW).
    • (c) Drop the offering into that temple's stone cauldron/brazier; grab an Astral Flame from the Forge and throw it in to burn it. A nearby zombie becomes marked (mist/fire runes).
    • (d) Lead the marked zombie to the correct Titan Trap and trigger it so the Titan crushes it: Dravakar → Caltheris Passage; Nyxara → outside Veytharion Passage; Caltheris → Caltheris Passage; Veytharion → Veytharion Passage. (Titan Traps sit near the Veytharion and Caltheris entrances, cost points, draw zombies in, then giant fists slam the ground — stand in the centre to be safe. Unconfirmed One source says the zombie must be killed by the correct fist.)
    • (e) Stone plate puzzle: interact with the hidden stone plate near the temple's central pillar, then perform the temple-specific action to open it — Dravakar: let a zombie damage you; Nyxara: go prone on it; Caltheris: stay still while ADS; Veytharion: repeatedly jump on it (~30 jumps per one guide). Hit the exposed button/dial with a charged Warden's Blight shot to raise it and summon a blue beam/laser; aim the laser (Void Claw on crystals where applicable) to open a wall and reveal a stone head/statue; shoot it — 4 Shadow Souls spawn (plus an Abomination in some temples; killing the Abomination is NOT required). Kill all 4 Shadow Souls. Then shoot the statue again where required.
    • (f) Final lightning strike: use the Void Claw to drag a purple orb beneath the Shadowsmith's head, hit it with a charged Warden's Blight shot to launch it into the skull (eyes glow purple). Trigger rain at the blue well if needed, get a fresh Astral Flame, throw it at the Shadowsmith's head — lightning strikes and cleanses the temple. Lightning targets per AllThings.How: Dravakar — forehead; Nyxara — nose (another guide says forehead — Unconfirmed conflict); Caltheris — forehead; Veytharion — top of the middle head / centre of forehead. Repeat for all 4 temples.
  7. Defeat the Warden (final boss). Go beneath PaP; all players stand in the blue circles to enter the boss arena. Fight guide below.

Wonder Weapon — Warden's Blight (Dual Crossbows)

Its charged shot is mandatory for later puzzles — PaP it the moment you have it.

  1. Create an Astral Flame: with the Void Claw, grapple the floating purple orb above the Nexus Forge and pull it into the centre of PaP (do NOT touch it — it turns to Salvage). Immediately turn a Crank Wheel; two Astral Flames appear beside PaP. (Astral Flame is reusable as a thrown projectile for several steps.)
  2. Get the Fracture of Nyxara: Dravakar Main Chamber — face SW, Void Claw up to the ledge above the entrance; destroy the breakable NW wall section (grenade/explosive, or a PhD Flopper dive per one source); take the Fracture behind it to Nyxara Main Chamber and place it in the empty pedestal on the north wall.
  3. Open Nyxara's Inner Sanctum: take an Astral Flame to Nyxara Sanctuary, face west, fire it into the large eye-shaped door; the purple projectile bounces between crystals — use the Void Claw on each crystal to rotate/redirect it, guiding the beam into Nyxara Main Chamber and into the locked south door. Timed — if the projectile fades, fetch another Astral Flame and restart.
  4. Get 3 Warden's Blight parts (hidden forest / Silent Area): inside the Inner Sanctum is a strange tree — stand under its roots and let them drain your health; on Round 8+, eat the fruit it produces to enter the forest (3-minute timer per one source; one player at a time per one source). Parts on corpses: central rock (middle of the forest), beside the burned cabin (melee the wooden panel beside the corpse), cave entrance (back-left). Unconfirmed — conflict KeenGamer says all 3 parts can be collected in a single visit; PlayHub/rexinfernus.wiki say only ONE part per visit, requiring 3 separate forest entries. This guide does not state either as certain — plan for 3 visits, be pleasantly surprised by 1.
  5. Solve Dravakar's lever/riddle puzzle: in Dravakar Sanctuary, interact with the glowing blue writing on the SW wall; Dravakar gives one of 4 randomised riddles (symbols: Star, Moon, Runner, Galaxy). Levers: L1 NE wall by the Armour wall buy; L2 east wall near the Ammo Box; L3 SE wall by the GobbleGum Machine. KeenGamer's solutions: “runner travels to stars, moons and galaxies stay true” = L2×2, L3×3 · “drift to the runner that travels moons, borrows from galaxies when stars stay true” = L1×3, L2×2, L3×1 · “drift to stars that remember moons, borrow the runner that travels the galaxy” = L1×1, L2×2, L3×2 · “remember galaxies that drift to moons, borrow the runner that travels the stars” = L1×2, L3×2. Interact with the central pillar — it lowers if correct. Grapple through the new ceiling opening to Dravakar Inner Sanctum; interact with Dravakar's Anvil to assemble/collect the Warden's Blight. PaP it immediately.

Note Temple and name spellings vary across sources (Nyxara/Nixara, Veytharion/Vtharian, Caltheris/Ctherreas, Dravakar/Dravacar, Aranea/Araenea). This guide uses one consistent set. The upgraded grapple is called “Void Talon” by AllThings.How; KeenGamer just calls it the upgraded Void Claw — same item, two names; which is the in-game name is unconfirmed.

Boss Fight — The Warden

  • The Warden (Jack McGregor) is fast and relentless. Loop: destroy the floating Dread Skulls around him to stun him; while stunned, shoot the glowing weak point on his tail (one source says “on top of his tail”) with your strongest weapon.
  • During immune phases, kill Shadow Souls and collect the ammo/armour drops; destroy Stingers immediately so they can't trigger the red-beam wipe attack.
  • Repeat until defeated. Bring Aether Shroud, Stim Shots, and a Perkaholic in reserve; use the Void Claw to escape when he closes in.
  • Ending: the final cutscene plays; this completes the Rex Infernus Main Quest and the BO7 round-based Zombies storyline. Rewards: Bloodthorn Wonder Weapon Skin, Rex Infernus Main Quest Calling Card, 10,000 XP; a unique Calling Card variant if completed before Directed Mode arrived. Unconfirmed Exact boss phase count in the main-quest fight — sources describe a single stun/tail loop; a 4th phase is reported only for the Boss Rush version.
New enemies on this map: Deathspinners — fast spiders; ranged web projectile slows you; abdomen weak spot; Dead Wire ammo mod effective. They appear in special rounds and drop Forge Panels. Web Mother — elite, appears ~Round 16; teleports, screams/lunges, lays slowing webs that can cover doors and perk machines, and cocoons zombies into hazards; skull weak spot; Shadow Rift and Light damage effective. Clear webs before relying on a blocked route or machine.

Super Easter Egg
Season 6 · Launched Sept 17, 2026 · Final Update Oct 14, 2026

Super Easter Egg — Toys & Boss Rush

The endgame that ties all six maps together. Prerequisite: complete all 6 round-based Main Quests — Ashes, Astra, Paradox, Totenreich, Kowakujo, Rex Infernus. Main Quests count in Standard, Cursed, or Directed Mode. Toy quests and Boss Rush are Standard or Cursed only — Directed does not support them.

The Six Toys

ToyMapWhere the full quest lives
Ol' Tessie ToyAshes of the DamnedAshes guide → Toy Quest
Caltheris ToyAstra MalorumAstra guide → Toy Quest (the longest one)
Twins DollsParadox JunctionParadox guide → Toy Quest
Guardian ToyTotenreichTotenreich guide → Toy Quest
Z-Rex ToyKowakujoKowakujo guide → Toy Quest
Warden Toy + Boss RushRex InfernusBelow — done last, in one continuous run
The exfil rule — do not skip this: each of the first five toys must be carried through a successful Exfil (defeat the HVT) to register permanently on the shelf upstairs in Her House on Rex Infernus. No Exfil = no registration. Toys can be collected in any order, across sessions. Once registered, the Warden Toy / Boss Rush can be replayed without re-collecting toys (reportedly Boss Rush can be started as early as Round 1 on replay). In co-op, each player must place their own Warden Toy on the shelf to get the rewards.

Warden Toy — Rex Infernus (One Continuous Run)

Prereqs: all 6 Main Quests done; 5 toys banked; Aether Shroud field upgrade; Frenzied Guard (for one horse challenge); PaP Warden's Blight. Must be done in one continuous run — no Save & Quit.

  1. Upgrade the Void Claw → Void Talon via the Eye of the Forge sequence (basketball → 4 symbols over 4 rounds → Exfil-round symbol order → HVT → Her House bathroom charged shot → Eye → apply to a Void Pedestal). Same steps as Rex Main Quest Step 3.
  2. Toy Box parkour: at Nyxara's Passage, look north beneath the bridge; grapple the small floating item/lock with the Void Talon — the whole team is transported to a floating-rock parkour course. Reach the summit within 90 seconds. At the top, a ghostly Toy Box tips over — activate it with Aether Shroud (interact while Aether Shroud is active). It opens, releases wisps, and spawns three floating horses on the main map. Swap to Frenzied Guard before returning.
  3. Three horse challenges: each horse floats above an island area; grapple to it, melee it mid-air — a spectral footwear item drops to the floor. Kill zombies in the specified way near it until it turns solid, then pick it up. Mapping (item → method is consistent across sources; area↔perk associations differ slightly): Shoes — kills while jumping (Spira Insula / near Jugger-Nog per BoostingFactory); Roller skates — kills with PhD Flopper explosions (Aranea Insula / near Widow's Wine); Shoelaces — kills with Frenzied Guard active (Ruinas Insula / near PhD Flopper). All three must be solid/collected — no partial credit.
  4. Trade-in: wait for an Exfil round (do NOT use the Exfil booth). A special portal appears near the Nexus Forge (pillar right of the house) — go through it back to Her House. Place the shoes + skates + laces into the toy box outside the house → receive the Warden Toy. Take it upstairs and place it on the shelf with the other five. The shelf glows purple = Boss Rush available.

Boss Rush — “Playdate with the Twins”

Interact with the completed 6-toy shelf in Her House to launch. Your team is dropped into Vettrunr's Sepulcher for five consecutive stages, no breaks (short prep window between stages with access to PaP, Arsenal, crafting table and Perk purchases; NO GobbleGum machine in the arena — bring your Gums beforehand):

  1. Z-Rex — returning boss; target weak points, avoid toxic attacks.
  2. The Guardian — break armour, target exposed weak points, dodge slam attacks.
  3. Demolition Derby — large zombie survival/kill challenge featuring Ol' Tessie (truck-driving stage — run zombies down; special enemies, heavy waves).
  4. Caltheris (the Needle) — returning boss; weak points, armour phases, rock attacks.
  5. The Warden — final boss; harder phases and prison mechanics (one source reports a 4th phase in this version — single-source, Unconfirmed).

Fail = restart the whole sequence, not from the last boss. After the Warden falls, the final Super Easter Egg ending plays. Unconfirmed MMOExp lists only 4 bosses (Z-Rex, Guardian, Caltheris, Warden), omitting Demolition Derby as a stage; BoostingFactory + AllThings.How list 5 stages including it. The 5-stage version above is the better-sourced one.

Boss Rush Rewards (All Permanent)

  • The Warden as a playable Operator (unlock text: “Survive a playdate with the Twins”).
  • Mr. Peeks Mayhem — a Cursed Round-Based Mode modifier (first full Boss Rush completion). Selected in the Relic menu but does NOT occupy a Relic slot. Effectively Cursed Tier III plus: Golden Armor available, Ultra weapon rarity, Pack-a-Punch IV unlocked, reduced PaP costs (reported: I 7,500 / II 20,000 / III 40,000 / IV 60,000 Essence), cheaper ammo (reported: unpacked 250, PaP I 1,250, II 3,000, III 6,000, IV 8,000), classic PaP weapon-taking animation, a random Ammo Mod on PaP, an Eternal Perk machine replacing Wunderfizz, and better Mr. Peeks egg / Mystery Box rewards. Limitations: NOT in Cursed Survival; no public Squad Fill (invite-only co-op only). Some players report a Mayhem activation bug (loads at Cursed Tier 0) with no confirmed fix as of the Oct 14 patch. Mayhem PaP/ammo prices are community-reported, not officially published.
  • Memento Mori skins — black-and-purple Dedicated Crew skins; ONE per Boss Rush completion, for the Operator you played as. Eight total (Dempsey, Nikolai, Takeo, Richtofen, Grey, Maya, Carver, Weaver). The full set = 8 successful Boss Rush runs, one per Operator; no confirmed bonus for collecting all eight.
